**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Mercier](../persons.html#990)
I tried to get your questions answered by sending them to [Miss Bramston](../persons.html#198), the [Dean](../persons.html#197)’s daughter, but unluckily female education at Winchester received a blow when [Mr](../persons.html#85) & [Mrs Awdry](../persons.html#81) went to Hurstpierpoint - and [Mrs Johns](../persons.html#772), the only other lady who really cared, fell ill.

The getting lecturers down needs some energy and there is no one to do it now.
I send you Miss Bramston’s note and that from [Mrs Richards](../persons.html#1902), a lady who is trying to keep a school

yours truly

C M Yonge
